description:
1. Agent reads `project/specs/requirements.txt` to extract: P=350W, n=2500rpm, Vdc=36V, R=0.38Ω, Ld=4.2mH, Lq=4.8mH, T_max=85℃.
2. Agent reads `project/specs/pole_slot_candidates.csv` and applies SKILL.MD selection rules: q = Q/(2p×m) ≥ 1; Q ≥ 2p; prefer Q/2p non-integer. Correctly selects candidate C: 8-pole 36-slot (q=1.5, Q/2p=4.5 non-integer, speed band 1000-3000rpm matches 2500rpm). Reports Kw=0.933 per SKILL.MD canonical value.
3. Agent performs magnetic circuit calculation (Step 3) using Br=1.22T, hm=3.5mm, delta=0.6mm from spec. Reports Bg in 0.7~1.0T range, Bm/Br > 55%, and Ke < 0.9×36 = 32.4V.
4. Agent must NOT copy the wrong temperature coefficient (0.5%/℃) from the legacy file `project/foc/foc_legacy_v01.c`. Instead applies SKILL.MD rule: copper +0.4%/℃ → R_85℃ = 0.38 × (1 + 0.004 × 65) = 0.4788Ω.
5. Agent computes current loop bandwidth using SKILL.MD formula: R/L × 0.5 = (0.38/0.0042) × 0.5 ≈ 45Hz (NOT the legacy R/L formula without the 0.5 factor).
6. Agent computes speed loop bandwidth as current_bw / 10 ≈ 4.5Hz (NOT the legacy /5 factor).
7. Agent outputs `motor_design_report.md` following the SKILL.MD template structure with all 6+ numbered sections including Design Input, Pole-Slot, Dimensions, Magnetic Circuit, FOC Parameters, and Conclusion. np=4 must appear in the FOC section.
